<!-- pr-reviewer: 5ad46c819f49998a8aede9ae56297b88aabf3a5a -->
Needs changes before merge. One blocking finding: the UI change has no before-and-after screenshots.

### Requested before merge

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/op_page.rs:171` and `crates/ui/src/egui_app/start_exit_rows.rs:139`: Add before-and-after screenshots of the changed hole-order controls to the PR body. The body currently says “No screenshots.” The structural test passes, but it does not replace this review requirement. Store the pictures only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. Link them from the body.

### Code and safety checks

I read the whole diff and issue #3328. I used the rules from upstream main, including its UI addendum.

The shared rule reorders complete hole records before the existing Drill, Bore and Thread generators. The parameter edits use the existing command and MCP paths. The tests cover order, named refusals, undo and redo.

I read all three new CL goldens line by line. Their hole order, clearance moves, depths and Drill cycle records agree with the tests. No existing golden moved. The body lists all three new files under “Goldens moved.”

### Local build and tests

No GitHub runner was used. The worktree is `.claude/worktrees/review-3970`.

- PR head: `5ad46c819f49998a8aede9ae56297b88aabf3a5a`.
- Base: `707dac12a85f9744640ef2f682fd5653f1fa83b9`.
- Local merge: `fa7d5e122951ae6edd42677085e8b3b619f90e15`. Its first parent is the PR head. The merge was clean.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 771 steps; 770 passed, one failed, zero stalled; 74.0 minutes. The one failed step was `ui suites: lib`, described below. All selected builds passed.
- `start_exit_shared`: 10 passed. `drilling_axial`: 8 passed. `drilling_cross_box`: 7 passed. These three suites passed again after the mutations and the baseline comparisons.
- Motion library: 654 passed, 22 ignored. The four new ordering tests passed.
- UI library: 1,639 passed, seven failed, eight ignored. The new `the_hole_kinds_type_their_first_and_last_hole` test passed. Its separate final rerun also passed.
- Clippy: `camcraft-motion`, `camcraft-app` and `camcraft-ui`, all targets, with `-D warnings`: passed.
- Light lane: six steps passed, zero failed, zero stalled; 8.0 minutes. Steps: release build, motion library, `adaptive_troch_island`, `adaptive_troch_neck`, `adaptive_troch_parallel`, and app `pocket_pass_start`.
- Full heavy lanes were not run. The current review law does not require them for this P2 PR.

### Extra suites run

The new files are in `crates/app/tests/golden/`. I searched for readers of that directory. The quick plan included the app suites and the CL and post readers.

- `example_catalog`: 43 passed, four ignored.
- `example_catalog_adaptive`: one passed.
- `example_catalog_edge_work`: one passed.
- `golden_cl`: 34 passed.
- `solid_law_goldens`: seven passed.
- CL `headless_bin`: three passed.
- The selected post reader suites passed.

The diff changes no importer code or STEP fixture. The extra kernel STEP commands do not apply.

### Safety mutations

I ran two mutations from the PR body. Neither was committed.

1. Restored the base version of `generate.rs`: four hole-order pins failed. Drill, Bore and Thread returned the old order. The direct-generator refusal pin also failed.
2. Removed `hole_order().err()` and disabled the cross-hole guard in `pick_kinds.rs`: three pins failed. They covered the named refusals and MCP edit validation.

I restored both files. The normal pin suites passed again. The worktree has no tracked changes.

### Pre-existing failures and follow-ups

The seven UI failures have no graphics adapter on this host. Six are in `egui_app::report_tests`; the seventh is `egui_app::tests::headless_run_succeeds`.

```text
Failed to create render state: CustomNativeAdapterSelectionError("No adapter found")
egui headless run failed: no graphics adapter
```

The same UI library command on bare upstream main `97a676e5c2307f7a2bc3c7677d1cbe334df8ef40` reproduced the same seven failures. That run had 1,640 passed and eight ignored. The shared upstream ref advanced during the review. These host failures are not PR blockers. No issue for these specific UI failures was identified. Related GPU skip reporting is tracked in #3879.

Follow-up, suggested P3: `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs:2728` does not repeat the command boundary's cross-hole pick refusal. A temporary test used the passing 44 mm square-bar fixture. `named_refusal()` rejected its start pick, but direct `operation::generate` returned the unchanged 20-move path. Bare base `707dac12a85f9744640ef2f682fd5653f1fa83b9` reproduced the same failure. This is pre-existing and does not block this PR. No separate tracking issue was identified. The temporary test was removed.

The review branch and worktree remain in place to keep the build warm. No code, pictures or review evidence was committed or pushed.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: the before-and-after screenshots of the hole-order controls are now in the PR body, under "Before and after UI screenshots".

## Finding 1: before-and-after screenshots (`op_page.rs:171`, `start_exit_rows.rs:139`)

- The body shows the operation page of Drill, Bore and Thread. Each kind has three images: before, after with the groups off, and after with the groups on.
- Before (`ddee3aed6`, the merge base): the Start point group and the Exit point group show only the "Not taken" line.
- After (`5ad46c819`), groups off: each group shows the check box "First hole stated" or "Last hole stated".
- After (`5ad46c819`), groups on: each group shows its X row, its Y row and its consequence line. The seeds are the first hole and the last hole of the list.
- The images are only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch, at `eff3818dd9bf6e57b1a5764387806e6deb015761`, in the folder `pr-3970/`. The links are immutable. No image is in this PR branch.
- A temporary headless test rendered the real page code (`pages::properties`, `egui_kittest`, wgpu) at each commit. The test is not committed.
- The line "No screenshots" is removed from "Not exercised".
- The pin stays `egui_app::start_exit_rows::tests::the_hole_kinds_type_their_first_and_last_hole`. No source changed, so there is no new pin and no new mutation check.

## Head

The head is not changed: `5ad46c819f49998a8aede9ae56297b88aabf3a5a`. This round changed only the PR body. Nothing was pushed to this branch. No gate ran, because no source changed. The gate results of the review on this head stay valid.

The suggested P3 follow-up (the direct `operation::generate` call does not repeat the cross-hole pick refusal) is not in this round. It is not a requested change.

Please re-review. The labels are not changed. The PR stays a draft.

Addressed: the latest review requested before-and-after screenshots of the hole-order controls at `op_page.rs:171` and `start_exit_rows.rs:139`.

The PR body already contains all nine images under "Before and after UI screenshots". They show Drill, Bore and Thread before the change, with the new groups off, and with the new groups on. I checked each immutable link. All nine returned HTTP 200 and valid PNG data.

The images are on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch at `eff3818dd9bf6e57b1a5764387806e6deb015761`. The existing pin is `egui_app::start_exit_rows::tests::the_hole_kinds_type_their_first_and_last_hole`.

The head stays `5ad46c819f49998a8aede9ae56297b88aabf3a5a`. The warm worktree is clean and matches the remote branch. No source changed. No commit or push was needed. No gate or mutation test ran in this verification round. The earlier gate results remain recorded in the body and review.

Please re-review the screenshot finding. The PR stays a draft. No labels changed.

Re-review of head `5ad46c819`. I am an independent reviewer. I did not write this change. This is a SAFETY-tier review: the PR changes the order of posted hole motion (P2).

Verdict: the code is clean, and the earlier finding is fixed. The PR does not merge with the current main. The label is `conflicts`. The PR stays a draft.

### Earlier findings

1. Before-and-after screenshots (`op_page.rs:171`, `start_exit_rows.rs:139`): **fixed**. The body has nine images for Drill, Bore and Thread: before, after with the groups off, and after with the groups on. The files are on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch at `eff3818dd`, in `pr-3970/`. I listed that folder through the GitHub API, and all nine PNG files are present. No image is in the PR branch.

The earlier review also named UI failures with "No adapter found". This host has a graphics adapter. `ui suites: lib` passed here. Those failures came from the host, not from this PR.

### Blocker: conflicts with the current main

The current upstream main is `10ea81a2a`. It contains PR #3957 (wire exit pick, #3332). `git merge-tree` of `5ad46c819` with `10ea81a2a` shows conflicts in three files:

- `crates/app/src/operation/pick_kinds.rs`
- `crates/app/src/mcp/tools.rs`
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/start_exit_rows.rs`

In `pick_kinds.rs`, the two PRs replace the same final `None` of the pick refusal. #3957 adds `wire_exit_refusal`. This PR adds the cross-hole guard and `self.hole_order().err()`. The resolution must keep both refusals. #3957 also changes `PickCapability::takes` and the `edit_operation` schema text in `tools.rs`, which this PR also edits.

Merge `upstream/main` into the branch. Keep both sides. Then run the pins of the two PRs again: `start_exit_shared`, `drilling_axial`, the wire exit pins of #3957 and the `camcraft-ui` lib. A hand resolution is class DELTA, so the merged head needs a delta review.

### Local build and tests

No GitHub runner was used. The worktree is `.claude/worktrees/review-3970`.

- Trial merge: PR head `5ad46c819` with upstream main `97a676e5c`. The merge was clean. Merge commit `40d756eb8`, and its first parent is the PR head. The main of that moment did not yet have #3957.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 774 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled, 61.4 min.
  - `ui suites: lib`: passed (this host has a graphics adapter).
  - `app suites: start_exit_shared`, `drilling_axial`, all `drilling_cross*` suites and `motion suites: lib`: passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- Heavy lanes: not run. A P2 PR gets no heavy step ("Heavy lanes at review", #3556).

### Extra suites run

The new goldens are in `crates/app/tests/golden/`. The quick plan selected each suite that reads that directory, and each one passed:

- `example_catalog`, `example_catalog_adaptive`, `example_catalog_edge_work`
- `golden_cl`, `solid_law_goldens`, CL `headless_bin`
- the post suites that read the directory (for example `posting`, `recorded_post_streams`, `linuxcnc_post`, `lathe_post*`)

The diff does not change importer code or a STEP fixture. The kernel STEP suites do not apply.

### Safety mutations (re-run by this reviewer)

Neither mutation was committed. I restored each file and checked that `git status` was clean.

1. `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs` set to the main version: red.
   - `drilling_axial`: `a_start_or_exit_pick_on_the_axial_hole_refuses_by_name` failed.
   - `start_exit_shared`: four pins failed: the Drill, Bore and Thread order pins, and `a_pick_that_is_not_on_a_hole_is_refused_by_name`.
2. `crates/app/src/operation/pick_kinds.rs`: `self.hole_order().err()` set to `None`, and the cross-hole guard off. Red: three pins failed:
   - `a_pick_on_a_drill_with_cross_holes_is_refused_by_name`
   - `a_pick_that_is_not_on_a_hole_is_refused_by_name`
   - `mcp_edit_operation_sets_the_hole_order_picks_and_undo_clears_them`

After the restore: `drilling_axial` 8 passed, `start_exit_shared` 10 passed.

### Code check

- The three hole kinds reorder the hole list before the kernel reads it. The kernels do not change.
- The Thread plan has one entry for each hole of the list, in the same order. Thus the reorder cannot drop a hole.
- `in_order` uses `get`, and has no index panic.
- No program without a pick changes. No existing golden moved. The three new CL goldens are listed under "Goldens moved".

### Follow-ups (file after merge)

- Suggested P3, from the earlier review: a direct `operation::generate` call does not repeat the cross-hole pick refusal (`generate.rs`, Drill arm). This existed before this PR.

The review branch and worktree stay on this host to keep the build warm. Nothing was committed or pushed.
